title: You do not need a finished story or a perfectly worded question.
subtitle: It is enough to sense that something needs attention. From there, we can find together what matters most right now.

direction.title: Too many directions are pulling at once
direction.description: You are facing a decision, transition, or new chapter and want to separate your own voice from outside expectations.

patterns.title: You notice recurring patterns
patterns.description: In relationships, communication, or the way you treat yourself, you keep arriving at the same place and want to understand what sustains it.

overload.title: You can carry a lot, but it has become too much
overload.description: Things may work on the outside, while inside there is growing tension, noise, or distance from how you want to live.

values.title: You want to move closer to what matters
values.description: There may be no crisis; you simply want to understand yourself and your values more clearly and choose your direction with intention.

approach.title: Together, we look from several angles to find a clearer picture.
approach.description: An integral perspective looks beyond what you think about a situation. We also pay attention to what you feel, what your body signals, the relational and environmental forces around you, and what can be carried into everyday life.

notice.title: Notice
notice.description: We slow down enough for what gets hidden in everyday momentum to become visible.

understand.title: Understand in context
understand.description: We consider inner experience, patterns, relationships, and environment together so the wider picture can emerge.

move.title: Find a step you can try
move.description: We connect insight to a next step that genuinely fits into your life.

contact.title: Let me know you would like to talk
contact.description: Use the form to briefly share what brings you here and suggest two or three times that could work.

first.title: A first 55-minute session
first.description: We get to know each other, explore your situation, and consider what direction could be useful.

continue.title: A direction we shape together
continue.description: If the meeting feels like a good foundation to both of us, we continue around your goals and at a pace that fits you.
